depiction_rules.notes: Keep the same Shiva design in stanzas 8–10; depict curiosity and realization with reverence, not lust or comedy.

visual_bible.appearance: Ash-pale blue-grey skin, matted dark hair with a small crescent moon, composed mature face, simple rudraksha and tiger-pattern waist cloth.
visual_bible.attributes: Trident may rest at his side in stanza 8; no weapon in the intimate garden scene.
visual_bible.body: One humanlike divine body with two attached arms and legs; natural adult proportions.
visual_bible.style: Matte mineral mural pigments, modest ornament and clear dark contour.
